Prompt contracts enforce JSON schema; JSON-mode retry handles provider incompatibilities. Frontend Next.js 16 + TypeScript; backend FastAPI + httpx. Groq models: whisper-large-v3 and a configurable chat/reasoning model. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Groq, Whisper, Prompt Engineering, Netlify.

Designed for free-tier hosting by keeping PyTorch off the deploy image. Tech: Python, Flask, FAISS, Groq, Hugging Face, Docker, Render.

Three Dockerized Python services orchestrated by Airflow: process_app chunks PDFs and embeds with MiniLM, analyst_app builds FAISS and analyzes with Groq, report_app renders PDF summaries with charts. GitHub Actions builds and pushes the three images. Tech: Airflow, Docker, FAISS, Groq, PyMuPDF, sentence-transformers, GitHub Actions.

Streamlit tool that parses long PDFs with pdfplumber, runs a Hugging Face prompt chain for executive summary and related sections, and exports LaTeX/PDF briefs.
